newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dlr ends near 8-yr low on greenback demand.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dlr ends near 8-yr low on greenback demand.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar flirted with an eight-year low and closed slightly lower against the U.S. dollar on Monday reflecting routine early-week greenback demand, but dealers said they saw limited downside for the local unit.
The local unit traded at an eight-year low T$27.926 through much of the session, but eventually closed just above that level at T$27.925 against Saturday's T$27.914 finish.
Turnover through dealers was an active US$296 million.
Despite nearing the eight-year low set on July 9, the market was relatively quiet on Monday and free of upsetting factors, dealers said.
